name: Paludal-Yardang
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed glass plains from an ancient cataclysm in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
the automated beacon of unknown purpose changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
For traders, iron, uranium and platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
